title_candidates: GPT-5.6 Sol preview shows where OpenAI is aiming next
summary: OpenAI previewed GPT-5.6 Sol, Terra, and Luna with stronger agent, coding, biology, and cyber capability, but access starts with a limited partner preview.

primary_source.title: Previewing GPT-5.6 Sol: a next-generation model
primary_source.author: OpenAI
key_facts: OpenAI previewed the GPT-5.6 family: Sol as the flagship model, Terra as a balanced model, and Luna as a faster, cheaper model.
The release starts as a limited preview for trusted partners before broader ChatGPT, Codex, and API availability.
OpenAI says GPT-5.6 adds max reasoning effort and an ultra mode that can use subagents for complex work.
OpenAI highlights gains in coding, biology workflows, and cybersecurity, paired with a stronger safeguard stack.
API pricing is listed separately for Sol, Terra, and Luna, with prompt caching changes for GPT-5.6 and later models.

prerequisites: A ChatGPT, Codex, or OpenAI API account
One task you already use AI for

steps.instruction: Open the OpenAI announcement and check whether your account has GPT-5.6 access yet.
If you do not have access, write down one existing workflow you want to retest when Sol, Terra, or Luna arrives.
Choose a task with a clear answer or review path, such as debugging a small project, summarizing a paper, or drafting a security checklist.
Save the same prompt and expected outcome so you can compare GPT-5.5 against GPT-5.6 later.
For work or sensitive data, wait for your organization's approved access path instead of pasting private material into a preview account.
